title: calculate_marker_genes_scanpy
description:
Calculate marker genes for clusters in a MuData object using scanpy's
`rank_genes_groups()` function.

Dataset input.title: Dataset input
Dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple         parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml                 blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: Path to the input MuData H5MU file.

modality.description: Name of the modality in the input MuData object.

input_layer.description: Name of the layer to use

obs_clustering.description:
Name of the `.obs` column that contains cluster assignments to
calculate marker genes for.

output.description: Path to the output MuData H5MU file.

output_markers.description: Path to the output CSV file where marker genes will be saved.

uns_output.description: Key in `.uns` where the results will be stored.

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

method.description: Statistical test used to identify marker genes.

corr_method.description: Method used to correct p-values for multiple testing

tie_correct.description: Whether to apply tie correction to the Wilcoxon test statistic

filter_results.description:
Whether to filter the results of `rank_genes_groups()` using
`filter_rank_genes_groups()`.

min_in_group_fraction.description: Minimum in-group fraction required for a marker gene.

max_out_group_fraction.description: Maximum out-group fraction allowed for a marker gene.

min_fold_change.description: Minimum log fold change required for a marker gene.

compare_abs.description: Whether to compare against absolute fold changes when filtering.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
